name: W. N. Thompson
role: Medora rancher, W. N. Thompson & Co.
bio: W. N. Thompson & Co. of Medora was among the outfits that planned to grow their herds in spring 1884. From October 1884 into January 1885 the firm advertised a $10 reward for a bay horse lost from the Little Missouri round-up. In April 1886 the firm was named in a report on cattle sales and prices.
